facts.fact: Morocco's Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform says in its institutional brochure that it adopted the Digital Morocco 2030 strategy, of which AI is an integral part, with an AI transversal lever (support the AI ecosystem, AI skills, responsible-use evaluation); the brochure gives no adoption date, so as_of is its published date (2024-09-18).
